items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They were after this guy who had the malaria because he was constantly complaining. His name was Buck Dyson.

ctx.x: You were telling us about this plot where the Soviets were trying to get…

Oh yes, okay. So, the sergeant that was in charge of—our spiritual leader. He discovered that the Soviet Union had put wires in our rooms to eavesdrop on conversation. They were after this guy who had the malaria because he was constantly complaining. His name was Buck Dyson. The man that they were after was Willie Cox. So Cox tells Dyson, “The next time they get in touch with you, tell them I want to see them.” That led to an arrangement where three Soviet agents met with Cox in a swanky club. It was one of…
Okay. Could we get you to go back to the Gordon Parks, telling us about Gordon Parks?
